svg.title: From Electrons to Releases — the whole climb, before the first step
svg.desc: The master diagram of the book, empty. Thirteen horizontal bands stacked from Physics at the bottom to Landing at the top, each holding small boxes for its chapters, all drawn in grey because no chapter has been read yet. Each chapter will light one box.
svg.text: From Electrons to Releases — the whole climb, before the first step
Read it from the bottom up. Each chapter lights one box; each box stands on the ones below it.
